title: Svitac Udruzenje - Videos
description:
Association for affirmation of children creations “Svitac” is founded in the year 2012 for the purpose of achieving aims in the field of social integration and inclusion of children and youth with disabilities into all aspects of social life as for the promotion of inclusion itself. Our main preoccupations are children and young people with disabilities, everyday work with them and promotion of their creations. We have cooperated with more than 300 children and adults from 3 to 28 years old so far. General public is not aware of their efforts so we are making our priority of their social inclusion through every our project: concerts, acting, public performances, TV and all other performances.

http://www.udruzenje-svitac.rs

https://www.facebook.com/udruzenjesvitac
